Option_A_Preserve_Compatibility.summary: Restore classroom_router.py, session_router.py, classroom_models.py ORM mappings, frontend classroom state/UI routes, and test_classroom_api.py.
pros: 100% HTTP backward compatibility for existing Classroom/Live Session users and scripts
cons: Reintroduces Classroom surface removed intentionally from candidate; requires integration testing alongside Step Editor & Landing/App split
Option_A_Preserve_Compatibility.rollback: Route feature flag or git revert commit restoring Classroom routers

Option_B_Intentional_Retirement.summary: Keep HTTP APIs retired (404), keep legacy DB tables read-only/intact (0 data loss), publish formal API retirement notice, changelog, and backup/export runbook.
pros: Smaller V1 attack/maintenance surface focused cleanly on Step Editor + Workspace; zero data loss in PostgreSQL
cons: Breaking change for any external consumer or Teacher/Student Classroom workflow expecting /api/classes/* or /api/sessions/*
Option_B_Intentional_Retirement.rollback: Git revert / restore routers from bb046fa22 without touching DB tables (since data was never dropped)

Preserve live unorbited camera pose and lens viewOffset across same-scene step-edit rebuilds in scene3d-view.tsx and SimulationWorkspace.tsx.
